title: •Jek Porkins
caption: •Jek Porkins (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. While piloting Red 6, it is Heroic, immune to attrition < 4, Jek draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise, and during your control phase, may use 1 Force to retrieve a Rogue squadron pilot or an X-Wing.
lore: Piloted Red 6 at Battle of Yavin. Specializes in strafing runs. Served in Tierfon Yellow Aces squadron at Tierfon Rebel Outpost. Free trader from Bestine system.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2; third stat box printed EMPTY (blank silver box, no label). Deploy 2 / forfeit 4. Yellow pilot icon + '2.' → {pilot:2} (stub expands). Icon column: pilot (helmet), warrior (blue, blaster). 'Rogue squadron' lower-case s and 'X-Wing' capital W as printed. CREDITS: printed HORIZONTALLY in italics along the bottom edge under the text box (not up the side margins): left 'Original concept by Kris Van Beurden', right 'V-Lite Ghent 2005' — stored as margin_left/margin_right; renderer may need a bottom-credit layout. Default wiki page is Glossary errata; printed face = 'Jek Porkins (Original)'. The 745 px Premiere-L-jekporkins.gif is the D-E1 errata face (art only, used as art.src); lore read off the 350 px decipher-archive scan (src/vs13/07-Premiere-L-jekporkins-decipher-archive.gif) and the 745 px face: matches the wiki. Copyright Premiere 1995 by set. Modern: VB1-L-jekporkins-pre.gif (350 px).
